snippet.title: Servant of the Lake - Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate!
snippet.description:
Download the demo on itch.io https://rustylake.itch.io/servant-of-the-lake?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Welcome to the Vanderboom house, home to the infamous Vanderboom family! Visitors are arriving soon, and you are meant to start your housekeeping duties immediately!

Solve the puzzles needed to fulfil your daily tasks, look after the household, welcome the visitor and ensure their comfort while helping the family achieve their alchemical ambitions! 

➡️ More from Rusty Lake https://rustylake.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
